standard_prerequisites.name: The dimension of a topological space as the supremum of the lengths of chains of irreducible closed subsets, and the lifting property for specializations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's sections on dimension functions and on specialization, before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the quantity to be compared and the hypothesis used to transport chains from the target to the source.

core_obligations: Transfer a chain from the target: given a chain of irreducible closed subsets of the target, the proof lifts the generic point of the largest member along the map and then uses the lifting property for specializations to produce points above the generic points of all the smaller members (proof lines 3991-4000).
Take closures in the source: the closures of those points give a chain of irreducible closed subsets of the source of the same length (proof lines 4000-4010).
The symmetric case: if generalizations lift instead, the same argument runs with the order of the chain reversed, and the author states that it is similar (proof line 4011).
Conclusion: the dimension of the source is at least the dimension of the target (proof lines 4010-4011).
proof_roadmap: 把目标里的一条不可约闭子集链先提升最大者的 generic point，再用 specialization 的提升性构造出源中的点列。
取这些点在源中的闭包得到同长度的不可约闭子集链，故 dim X >= dim Y；generalizations 提升的情形把链反向，论证相同。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the dimension comparison for a surjective map onto a sober space along which specializations (or generalizations) lift (author lemma at source lines 3982-3988, label lemma-dimension-specializations-lift). The proof (source lines 3990-4012) carries content in the lifting step: from a chain of irreducible closed subsets of the target the author lifts the generic point of the largest member and then climbs down the chain using the lifting hypothesis to obtain points whose closures form a chain of the same length in the source (proof lines 3991-4010). Sobriety of the target is what makes the generic points available in the first place. H2.
